golden-snitch.label: Golden Snitch
golden-snitch.intro: Golden Snitch illustrations show the winged ball in flight, on workbenches, among Quidditch equipment and in small keepsake displays. Close-up objects sit alongside scenes with gloves, books and curious owls.

sorting-hat.label: Sorting Hat
sorting-hat.intro: The patched Sorting Hat appears with repair tools, house banners, school trunks and watchful animals. Other scenes pair the hat with students, portraits, chess pieces and floating candles.

ron-weasley.label: Ron Weasley
ron-weasley.intro: Ron Weasley scenes include wand repairs, wizard chess, Quidditch and school-day mishaps. The collection mixes expressive close-ups with larger illustrations of the red-haired character and his familiar equipment.

fantasy-crafts.label: Fantasy crafts and inventions
fantasy-crafts.intro: Fantasy makers tend miniature gardens, build unusual instruments and shape enchanted objects. Mechanical insects, a giant planted boot and a tiny leaf boat bring different scales and materials into these workshop scenes.

fantasy-headwear.label: Fantasy headwear
fantasy-headwear.intro: Explore crescent hats, crystal aviator headgear, living branch crowns and delicate insect-wing headdresses. Each design has its own silhouette, with pearls, folded metal, clouds or leaves shaping the details.

football-couple.label: Football couples
football-couple.intro: Football couples share game-day celebrations, quiet radio breaks, practice drills and equipment projects. The scenes include players and supporters of different ages, with affectionate portraits alongside full-body activities.

football-love.label: Football fans and hobbies
football-love.intro: Football enthusiasm appears in personal keepsakes, baking, knitting, model stadiums and carefully maintained equipment. Fan portraits and small arrangements offer alternatives to on-field action scenes.

football-heart.label: Football hearts
football-heart.intro: Football leather, laces and field markings form hearts with different structures. Discover clockwork mechanisms, glass ornaments, balloons, growing plants and small inventions alongside simpler stitched heart shapes.

football-valentine.label: Football Valentine
football-valentine.intro: American football meets Valentine's Day in heart-marked players, playful mascots and gift arrangements. Roses, chocolates, ribbons and blank cards accompany the footballs, while character scenes show training and celebrations.

basketball-bracket.label: Basketball brackets
basketball-bracket.intro: Basketball tournament bracket illustrations appear on chalkboards, clipboards, jerseys and screens. Additional designs arrange the blank entry boxes as trees, stepped paths and trophy-centered diagrams.

hogwarts.label: Hogwarts
hogwarts.intro: Explore Hogwarts through castle views, classrooms, house common rooms and lakeside scenes. The illustrations also visit the Great Hall, library, greenhouses and Quidditch pitch in both color and monochrome.
